titulo: Lindsay Clancy’s attorney asks Trump to pardon her in first interview after mistrial
cuerpo: Kevin Reddington spoke for the first time Tuesday about what comes next for Clancy, after the jury was split 11-to-1 over whether the 36-year-old former nurse is criminally responsible for killing Cora, 5, Dawson, 3, and 8-month-old Callan in 2023
